paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Polarity scores for Indonesia
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores for vaccine-related sentiments in Indonesia. The x-axis represents polarity scores with a linear scale, ranging from -1.0 to 0.6, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents counts with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 35000, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 5000. The plot features a single blue line with circular markers and a solid line style. The line starts at approximately 0 counts at a polarity score of -1.0, increases gradually to around 5000 counts at a polarity score of -0.6, then rises sharply to a peak of about 35000 counts at a polarity score of 0.0, before declining to around 2000 counts at a polarity score of 0.6.
